brief:
Al-Shifa Medical Complex in Gaza inaugurated a hematology and oncology department after rehabilitation funded by Turkey, the Shehab Wire reported. The reopening aims to restore care for cancer patients who suffered during the conflict and the destruction of the Turkish hospital.

The ward's restoration follows extensive damage to Gaza's medical infrastructure during the war, leaving oncology patients without dedicated treatment facilities in the territory.

title: Al-Shifa hospital opens hematology and oncology ward in Gaza
